verdict.rationale: Anrok supports certificate collection and storage via UI/API, and pricing page states certificates are "collected, verified, and stored," with customer search enabling pre-billing certificate upload. However, there is no evidence of expiry tracking or explicit automatic application of certificates at tax-calculation time within the evidence pack. missing for 10: expiry tracking/alerting on certificates, explicit description of certificates being auto-applied during tax calculation, independent verification of the certificate workflow.
